title: feat(plugin-detail): a double-click on the record page details divider resets the column to its default width
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbVF7sWPNE4HmjkgyaVxQYif)_
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRaJbQ4vqdv4J5peqA

Fixes #36226

Clause-②: no — no public type or accept set; one interaction on an existing control
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 宽屏打开记录整页时，左边字段栏和右边页签之间的分隔线，双击就回到默认宽度 400，并且记住；以前只能拖动或用方向键调。
- 属于「记录页对标 Attio」专题：这张卡的五条里只差「双击复位」这一条，其余四条（可拖的分隔线、拖动范围、按人按对象记住宽度、评论栏不动）此前的记录页改版已经做完。
- 碰到的只是在宽屏记录整页双击分隔线的人；出错最多是双击没反应或宽度不对，拖动和键盘照常能用，这次改动可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- The record full page's pinned left column (the details beside the tabs on a wide full page) already has a divider, `DetailsWidthHandle`, that drags, moves with the arrow keys and Home / End, and keeps the width per reader and per object. A **double-click** on it now keeps `RECORD_PAGE_DETAILS_WIDTH` (400), the same constant the page falls back to when nothing is kept (the console's workspace preference passes it as the fallback; the plugin's own clamp uses it for an absent width). So the reset writes the default as the kept width, and the next record of that object opens at 400.
- The double-click clears any in-flight drag and its preview first, so a press still down when it lands does not go on to preview or commit a width.
- Card items 1, 2, 4 and 5 were already delivered by #36136 and #35890: the divider, its limits, the remembered width, and the comment panel left unchanged. This PR adds item 3, the double-click reset. The card's own numbers (a right rail of 320, dragged between 280 and 560) describe the rail that #36136 removed. The default reset to here is #35890's 「左栏宽 400」, not a new number.
- README: one paragraph on the pinned column's divider (drag, keys, double-click, host-kept width).

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`: the `onDoubleClick` on `DetailsWidthHandle`. It commits the unclamped default, never `clamp(400)`, so a narrow window does not store a smaller width as "the default".
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.test.tsx`: the new `it` in the objectstack#35890 describe, with a host stand-in that re-reads its store on every mount.

## Tests

`aria-valuenow` on the separator, read from the new test:

| step | before this PR (handler ablated) | this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| drag 400 → 520 | 520 | 520 |
| double-click | 520 | **400** |
| move + release after the double-click | n/a (the test is already red) | 400 (no preview, nothing kept) |
| remount from the kept store | n/a | **400** |

<details><summary>Green on 56118cbc2f: RecordPageColumns.test.tsx</summary>

```text
cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.test.tsx
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  36 passed (36)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (once): the reset's commit removed, the pin reds, then restored</summary>

```text
node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file .../RecordPageColumns.tsx --anchor 'onCommit(RECORD_PAGE_DETAILS_WIDTH);' --delete --hold
anchor count now: 0
 FAIL  ... > a double-click on the handle keeps the default 400 again, ends a drag, and the default holds on the next open (objectstack#36226)
AssertionError: expected '520' to be '400' // Object.is equality
      Tests  1 failed | 35 passed (36)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (a35b42507591) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
</details>

<details><summary>Real browser: a double-click still fires on this handle</summary>

The handle calls `preventDefault()` on `pointerdown` and captures the pointer. In headless Chromium (Playwright 1.63, `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`), a raw element wired the same way and double-clicked logs `["down","up","down","up","dblclick:drag=null"]`. So `dblclick` fires, and it fires after the second `pointerup`, when no drag is held any more. No screenshot is attached. The table above is the before/after.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Keyboard reset: not added. No separator in `ui/` resets from the keyboard. The record drawer's resize handle and the Gantt splitter both reset on double-click only, so there is no convention to follow. Home / End / arrows stay as they were.
- The README's record-page section still describes the two-column tiers from before #35890 (for example "there is no tabbed tier"). This PR adds only the divider paragraph and does not rewrite the section.

## Verification

Two minutes: on a wide window (content at least 744 px), open any record as a full page. Drag the divider between the fields and the tabs, then double-click it. The fields column snaps back to 400 px. Open another record of the same object and it is still 400.
